title: Agentic RFQ Broker — Customer Submits, We Send Bids to Tradesmens
description: Customer submits job requirement. System sends structured bids to tradesmens WhatsApp/phone. They tick yes/no. We get details. Free trial, charge for lead, no platform fee.

customer_flow: Customer submits job (photo + description + location + preferred time)
Agents contact qualified suppliers via WhatsApp/API/email/phone
Each response turns into structured quote
Customer receives three actually executable offers, not three phone numbers
supplier_flow: Tradesman receives WhatsApp: NEW LEAD + job details
System captures: service_area, acceptance_behaviour, actual_availability, price, job_types_accepted, response_time, conversion
architecture.monetization: Charge for lead, no platform fee. Loss leader to build graph.
